brihadaranyaka_chapter3_verse4.title: Brihadaranyaka Chapter 3 Verse 4
brihadaranyaka_chapter3_verse4.introduction: This verse belongs to Brihadaranyaka, Chapter 3.
brihadaranyaka_chapter3_verse4.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Brihadaranyaka Upanishad, Chapter 3, Verse 4, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
brihadaranyaka_chapter3_verse4.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
